clips.title: The story
paras: Pilot Hammerfoot waits at the wrecked siege engine, fearing for Mori Hildelve in Dun Morogh's crags. Hildelve went on foot to find rare ore for potent blastpowder, but days have passed, and roars echo through the peaks.

Pilot Mori Hildelve drove his siege engine up Dun Morogh's steep, jagged ridges while searching for rare ore needed to make high-grade blastpowder. The machine broke on the slope. Hildelve left Pilot Hammerfoot at the camp to guard the wreckage, then continued higher into the frozen wilderness on foot.

Days passed without Hildelve returning to camp. At night, vicious growls echoed from the rocky crags, and Hammerfoot's impatience turned to dread. Hildelve was known for his toughness, but the frigid heights offered little protection from prowling predators without his engine or heavy support.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills. We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!
Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.
It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night. Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers. Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve. And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.
This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
